name: Grimmling Warband
description: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Cowardly
abilities.description: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.
